text: Figure 2.21: Example 3 - DIO - Accessed by Dem Master and Satellite As shown in the example, DIO reports a diagnostic error to DEM. The call to DEM is issued on the core it occurs. DIO is not responsible to change the call context to another core. This of course requires that DEM provides its service API to the according core / partition.
